        max(man_patches[0].lower, closest_blue.lower),
        min(man_patches[0].right, closest_blue.right),
        min(man_patches[0].upper, closest_blue.upper)
    )

    baby_patch = max(baby_patches, key=lambda patch: (patch.right - patch.left) * (patch.upper - patch.lower))

    gender = baby_patch.llm_query("Is the baby a boy or a girl?", long_answer=False)
    age = baby_patch.llm_query("How old is the baby?", long_answer=False)

    return f"A baby was found in the image. It appears to be a {gender} around {age}."
